lessons.strand: PfA: Independent Living, Careers & Vocational (ASDAN)
lessons.title: Snack Planner: Choose, Check, Sequence
lessons.focus: Plan one simple snack from locally approved options that meets a fictional/class food-pattern cue—such as a fruit or vegetable component or food-group variety—without judging anybody's body, diet or food preferences.
lessons.coreOutcome: Plan a simple healthy snack.
lessons.inheritedMapping: ASDAN Living Independently / Foodwise (Entry) · PfA · AQA UAS.
lessons.inheritedEvidence: ASDAN short-course evidence; AQA UAS 'Looking after myself', 'Household tasks' (unit unconfirmed — centre record). F: task observation. S: independence portfolio start (Dec).
lessons.qualificationStatus: Teaching/rehearsal · potential evidence: assessor review required.
lessons.evidenceCandidate: Dated snack plan + stated fictional food-pattern cue + observed pupil combination choice/sort + pupil criterion reason + separate note of adult preparation, prompting or scribing.
lessons.lundyPrompt: VOICE: Show or say the most important choice in your plan. AUDIENCE: Tell the receiving adult the safety check and why it matters. NEXT: Choose picture, written or no-food format; the adult confirms whether the plan will be used in the next named authorised/no-food session or explains the boundary and equal alternative.

lessons.evidenceCandidate: Adult observation of the safe sequence + before/after checklist or authorised image + pupil finish judgement/reason + exact support level.
lessons.lundyPrompt: VOICE: Show or say one job you completed. AUDIENCE: Tell the adult what your finish check showed. NEXT: Choose one prompt or tool to keep, change or fade; the adult states before close what will be different at the next clean-up.
